subject: Discovery follow-up: proposed rotating office-hours grid for technical deep dive
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery@redwood.com>
To: Alex Nguyen <alex@clearwavehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya@clearwavehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Jun 2025 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up: proposed rotating office-hours grid for technical deep dive

Alex / Priya — great conversation earlier, thanks for carving out the time. Quick written recap + a concrete next-steps proposal so we can lock the technical deep dive.

Recap (high level)
- Primary goal: validate inference economics and multi-tenant isolation for a production POC (1–3 models, ~200–500 qps peaks).
- Key stakeholders: Alex (platform/infra), Priya (security/compliance), CTO will want a short exec recap later.
- Constraints: data residency for logs, SOC2 evidence, and predictable latency under 50ms p50 for common prompts.

Proposed next step: 60–75 minute technical deep dive with a Redwood solutions engineer + your infra/security folks. Because your team spans NA / EMEA / APAC, I want to suggest a rotating "office-hours grid" so we can run recurring deep dives that are friendly to different time zones and keep momentum. This avoids repeating the same scheduling back-and-forth.

Rotation idea (three-week cadence)
- Week A (Americas focus): 9:00–10:15 PT (45 min demo + 30 min Q&A) — ideal for your West/US teams.
- Week B (EMEA focus): 15:00–16:15 CEST (45 min demo + 30 min Q&A) — ideal for EU infra/security.
- Week C (APAC focus): 09:00–10:15 AEST / 09:00 SGT (45 min demo + 30 min Q&A) — ideal for APAC timezone attendees.

Logistics
- I attached a one-page rotating grid (rotating-office-hours-grid.xlsx) and a short SOW draft for the POC scope.
- Proposed cadence: bi-weekly rotations for the first 6 weeks (so you get two sessions targeting each region) — we can adjust cadence after the initial run.
- We'll send three recurring calendar invites (one per slot) and ask your team to RSVP to the slot that works best; we’ll consolidate attendees the day prior.

Ask from your side
1) Can you confirm which technical people should attend (platform lead, SRE, security/compliance rep)?
2) For the deep dive, is 60–75 minutes ok or do you want a tighter 45-minute session?
3) Any blackout dates in the next 3 weeks?

If that sounds good I’ll ping Ben (SE) and Soojin (SE Manager) to propose concrete dates for the next three rotations. I’ve also put a Calendly link in case you prefer picking a single time now: https://calendly.com/redwood/clearwave-deep-dive

Thanks — happy to adapt the windows if you’d prefer a different cadence.

— Avery Johnson
Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
avery@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

Avery — appreciate the clear recap. We’re excited to move forward. A few quick notes: 

- Attendees: I’ll bring our Platform Lead (me), I’ll ask Priya (security) and our SRE lead (Anita) to join the first session. If possible, include a short segment on KV cache behavior and model fallbacks — that’s our top technical risk.
- Session length: 75 minutes sounds right for the first deep dive (demo + Q&A + a short mapping of our infra).
- Availability: next week (Jun 30–Jul 4) is tight for our EU folks due to holidays; good windows for us are Jul 7–11 or Jul 14–18. We prefer an EMEA-friendly time for the first technical session so our security folks can attend.

We’re comfortable with the rotation plan. The questions we have right now:
- What does Redwood need from us pre-call (config, sample prompts, test dataset)?
- What’s the expected timeline from proof-of-concept -> pilot?

I can confirm attendees by EOD Thu. If you can propose specific dates/times for the EMEA slot during Jul 7–18 that would be very helpful.

Thanks,
Alex

- Week C (APAC window): Wednesday, Jul 23, 2025 — 09:00–10:15 AEST (demo + Q&A).

Prep checklist for your team (small asks before the first session)
- A sample prompt set (5–10 prompts) and one representative inference payload shape (JSON)
- Any network constraints (IP allowlist) or KMS restrictions for demo accounts
- Short list of success metrics (latency targets, throughput, cost per 1k requests) — we’ll map them to configurations during the call.

Next steps from our side
- Ben will object and confirm the SE who will lead the demo and will set the three recurring invites with RSVP options.
- I’ll upload the SOW-draft-v0.1.pdf and the rotating-office-hours-grid.xlsx to the linked doc and share links.

If the Jul 16 EMEA slot works for you I’ll mark that as the first session and we’ll invite the relevant Redwood SEs. Let me know by EOD Thu.

Best,
